chapter.heading: A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
I lift
up my eyes to you,you who sit in the heavens.

Behold, as
the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God,until he has mercy on us.

Have mercy
on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us,for we have endured much contempt.

Our soul
is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease,with the contempt of the proud.
